messages:
lucy: dropping a proposed compact "progress strip" for first-run onboarding. Figma link posted. idea: horizontal compact checklist at top of console that shows 3 steps (create project, connect model, run quickstart). keeps users oriented without a modal.

dan: saw it. main engineering question: should the strip be persistent or dismissible? persistent might take real estate but reminds users.

maria: prefer dismissible with resume affordance (small pill in header) so power users can clear it. default visible for new accounts only.

toby: accessibility note: if it's live-updating (progress changes), we need an aria-live region to announce step completions to screen readers. also ensure focusable controls for each step.

lucy: good point. plan: each step is a button with aria-pressed state and aria-describedby for helper text. when a step completes, update a visually-hidden live region: "Step 2 of 3 completed: Model connected."

aria: color/contrast nits: the progress filler uses --accent-50 which is borderline on dark mode. change to --accent-60 and keep the remaining bar at --muted-2. Also ensure label text meets 4.5:1 because it's primary action text.

dan: implementation detail: strip should collapse to an icon-only compact pill on very narrow widths to avoid wrapping. we can use CSS grid and a data-state attribute.

maria: copy review: current step titles are terse: "Connect model" -> change to "Connect a model to your project". CTAs: primary = "Complete step" vs more task-specific like "Add API key". prefer specific.

toby: suggestion: use contextual CTA per step, e.g. Step 1 CTA "Create project", Step 2 CTA "Add model", Step 3 CTA "Run quickstart". reduces cognitive overhead.

lucy: agreed. also adding microcopy under each button: "Estimated time: 2 min" for clarity.

aria: keyboard behavior: tabbing into the strip focuses step 1; arrow keys move between steps; Enter triggers the CTA. ensure roving tabindex pattern.

dan: virtualization conflict: console header uses sticky positioning; we'll need to ensure the strip's z-index and focus order don't interfere with other sticky headers. i'll add ENG-4710.

qa-bot: checklist reminder: include keyboard tests, screenreader narration tests, color contrast report, responsive collapse behavior. attach results to PR.

maria: analytics: add events onboarding_strip_shown, onboarding_step_clicked, onboarding_step_completed. want to A/B test wording for step 3 CTA: "Run quickstart" vs "Open quickstart". keys: onboarding_strip_cta_v1/v2.

lucy: experiment note: also track time_to_first_token_generation metric for correlation.

toby: small animation note: when a step completes, show a subtle confetti micro-interaction but only for users with reduced-motion disabled. otherwise show a simple check icon.

aria: accessibility follow-up: ensure reduced-motion respects prefers-reduced-motion; update motion token. also add aria-hidden on decorative confetti.

dan: i'll scope the CSS + JS changes into a small PR. will include a feature flag for rollout.

lucy: will update Figma with copy and motion states and lock tokens. pinging i18n for translations after copy lock.

maria: can folks add final copy tweaks by EOD Tuesday? planning to hand off to i18n Wed.

qa-bot: auto: schedule accessibility QA session: 2026-04-07T17:00:00Z. invite sent.

dan: PR incoming ENG-4710, linking here when ready. :rocket:
